messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — proposing a compact "micro-lab" webinar (35–45m) focused on cost/latency tradeoffs for real-time apps. Thinking: 8–10 min framing, 12–15 min demo, 10 min audience labs + 5 min wrap. Who can own the demo prompts + run-of-slots?
Evan (Product): I can own demo prompts. Suggest we do 3 short scenarios: chat customer support, live-code summarization, and streaming agent fallback. Keep each scenario to ~4 min.
Riya (DevEx): I’ll assemble a prompt slate and canonical prompt bank. Can we standardize input formats (JSON with metadata) so demos are repeatable?
Sam (Ops): Need a rehearsal checklist. Also we should simulate a cross-region latency spike and show fallback routing. I'll draft a failover cue and a monitoring panel snapshot. :eyes:
Leo (Eng): Happy to add a tiny harness that toggles model variants mid-demo. I’ll prepare a script:
```
# demo toggle script (pseudo)
POST /demo/toggle {"variant":"low-cost"}
sleep 6
POST /demo/toggle {"variant":"low-latency"}
```
Maya (Marketing): Nice. Two asks: (1) a short abstract for registration page (1-2 sentences), (2) an ops-safe run-of-show we can rehearse in 30m.
Evan (Product): Draft abstract: "Practical strategies for serving interactive LLM features at production scale — design patterns, cost/latency knobs, and live demos you can replicate." Keep it punchy.
Riya (DevEx): Run-of-show (first pass):
• 00:00–02:00 — Welcome + goals
• 02:00–10:00 — Product framing + patterns
• 10:00–25:00 — 3x 4–5min micro-demos (scenario intro + run)
• 25:00–33:00 — Interactive labs (attendees try prompts / ask)
• 33:00–38:00 — Q&A + next steps
Sam (Ops): Ops checklist highlights: staging endpoint w/ replay tokens, canary traffic rule for demo window, fallback policy pre-set, rollout pin to avoid autoscale surprises. Add a smoke test 10m before live.
Maya (Marketing): For inbound routing: can we tag registrants by intent (prototype vs enterprise) so SDRs get prioritized leads? What's minimal payload we need?
Leo (Eng): Add lead payload fields: "use_case", "team_size", "priority_contact". We'll wire a webhook to /leads/webinar. I'll stub the mapping in prod-sim.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging/demo-harness v1.7 -> staging at 1742938540 by Leo
Riya (DevEx): Rehearsal plan:
• Dry run 1 (internal): Tue 10:00 — full script, validate toggles
• Dry run 2 (ops+eng): Wed 16:00 — simulate latency/fallback
• Final dress: Thu 09:30 — full tech + host cues
Maya (Marketing): Speakers: Evan (product), Leo (eng), Riya (devex) — we still need a moderator/host. Any volunteers?
Sam (Ops): I can host the backstage comms and be co-host for monitoring, but not public-facing. Suggest Emma from Growth as moderator. @Emma?
Evan (Product): @Emma ping — can you moderate? Short script will be provided.
Maya (Marketing): Cool. Action items: Evan -> finalize demo scenarios + 1-sentence registration blurbs (due EOD); Riya -> prompt bank + rehearsal timestamps (due tomorrow morning); Sam -> ops checklist + smoke test (due day before); Leo -> demo toggle harness + webhook mapping (staging by end of day).
Leo (Eng): Acknowledge — will push harness and webhook stub to staging branch.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll draft registration copy and share invite once we lock times. :tada:
